costs.starterBody: 100 users, 4 searches each month, up to 10 pages per search
costs.growthBody: 1,000 users, 8 searches each month, up to 10 pages per search
costs.growthCost: About €72 per month, plus measured AI and email
costs.starterGateway: AI Gateway: hard-capped at $10 per month

costs.growthGateway: AI Gateway: resize the current $10 cap from measured token usage

costs.note: Public list prices checked on 30 August 2026. Firecrawl is shown in EUR for Germany; other providers are shown in USD. Taxes, exchange rates, overages, and model usage can change. The live provider dashboards remain the source of truth.
